scope: SHRESTA EXCLUSIVE saree-focused premium quick commerce web frontend
nonNegotiables: Use TypeScript strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled.
Never use any. Use unknown with type guards when external data is not yet typed.
All money displayed by the frontend arrives as paise and is formatted in one currency utility.
The frontend never computes trusted order totals. Server-priced responses are the source of truth.
Cloudinary public_id is passed to a URL builder; full Cloudinary URLs are not treated as durable domain data.
TanStack Query owns server state. Zustand is UI-only state such as drawers, dialogs, and navigation chrome.
Cart, checkout, orders, and profile screens are client-rendered and never globally cached.
Product detail pages may use ISR; listing/search pages must remain fresh enough for inventory-aware SEO.
Storefront, category, asset, and product-like merchandising datasets are never hard-coded in the frontend.
Frontend customer and admin product surfaces render product names, prices, SKUs, badges, category membership, and images only from SHRESTA-BE responses.
Backend API connection failures and backend API 404 responses render the shared API-not-reachable state on SSR customer/admin pages.
Frontend routes that do not exist render the shared SHRESTA page-not-available route instead of a default framework 404 page.
Featured collection product inclusion uses backend metadata such as productBadgeFilters and shared resolver logic; no collection slug gets one-off frontend filtering.
Store locator marker positions and search zoom behavior use backend store records and coordinates from GET /api/v1/storefront/stores through the client-only Leaflet map.
The store locator Leaflet map imports Leaflet inside the client effect and must not be wrapped in a next/dynamic bailout that can leave the map blank.
Customer routes linked from the storefront shell should remain visually aligned with the old SHRESTA reference page structures while sourcing all data from SHRESTA-BE APIs.
Admin mutations run through server actions, forward Idempotency-Key, and keep SHRESTA_ADMIN_API_KEY server-only.
Admin create/update/archive/delete submissions run through a reviewer-visible change request queue before records are changed or removed.
Admin asset tag inputs must enforce the backend media_assets.tags contract: uppercase token values only, 40 characters per tag, and 16 tags per asset.
Admin ACL has four roles only: SUPER_ADMIN, CHANGE_SUBMITTER, CHANGE_REVIEWER, and CHANGE_MANAGER.

Customer login is required before Proceed To Checkout creates a backend checkout order ID and before final confirm-and-pay/order placement; browsing, cart viewing, wishlist viewing, and checkout review remain public.
Proceed To Checkout uses the same-origin /api/customer-orders/draft proxy, requires an Idempotency-Key, and stores only 15-minute draft metadata in the browser.
Any browser cart change after checkout draft creation clears the local draft; final confirm must include draftOrderId and reject missing, expired, or cart-mismatched draft metadata.
Customer order placement uses the same-origin /api/customer-orders proxy, requires draftOrderId plus an Idempotency-Key, and treats SHRESTA-BE totals/statuses/item snapshots as truth.
Customer order summaries for /account use GET /api/customer-orders and are keyed by authenticated customerId, so email and phone identities mapped to the same customer show the same order history.
Customer login/profile state is backend-owned and exposed to React only through same-origin APIs backed by an HTTP-only session cookie.
SHRESTA is a quick-commerce platform; customer-facing delivery promises must use minutes, hours, or same-day slots and must not drift into multi-day ecommerce shipping copy.
Customer-facing UI copy must not expose implementation language such as backend, API, DB, KV, S3, CDN, metadata, contract, snapshots, or events; use SHRESTA/customer language instead.

Every current and future screen must be responsive across mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop, and wide monitor viewports. UI work must include top-to-bottom manual or browser-assisted verification for all affected routes and interaction states using a review-identify-fix-rereview loop.
ProductCard.description and ProductCard.longDescription are backend-owned customer-facing copy used by customer PDPs.
The SHRESTA Assistant chat widget is icon-only when closed, reveals text only on hover/focus, and sends messages through the backend-owned customer chat API.
Frontend media rendering uses backend-provided S3/CDN variant URLs, dimensions, versioned/cache-busted URLs, and LQIP metadata.
Tailwind utility styling depends on @tailwindcss/postcss and SHRESTA @theme tokens in globals.css; visual changes must not remove this pipeline.
Every significant component, hook, and utility has AI context before it is considered complete.
.ai documentation and mind maps are updated in the same change as code, API, dependency, config, or UI architecture changes.

categoryFoundation.rule: All filters, badges, SEO, PDP attributes, recommendations, and merchandising surfaces come from category configuration.

storefrontFoundation.rule: Home page brand, navigation, announcement, hero, trust, collection, bestseller, material, newsletter, footer, mobile nav, and live-chat entry surfaces are rendered from backend-owned data plus local UI state. Collection counts, product inclusion, and customer-facing product descriptions use backend product-card data plus generic metadata filters, while visible customer copy stays implementation-free.

adminFoundation.rule: Admin forms expose backend-owned asset/category editable fields, allow existing asset image replacement through the backend multipart API, and submit governed change requests for create/update/archive/delete flows; frontend-only layout/copy controls are not primary admin dashboard data.
